record.reason: The primary abstract proposes injecting knowledge-graph triples into BERT inputs using soft positions and a visible matrix to improve domain-specific language representation, reporting results on NLP tasks. It does not study generative LLM inference/serving or an inference-time efficiency technique; the stated contribution is knowledge-enhanced representation quality.
record.title: K-BERT: Enabling Language Representation with Knowledge Graph
